reason: Not classified at 24 or 48 h (combinations disagree). Host reading, not a classification: none of the 40 BMG/Ti6Al4V combinations reached the declared decrease band (lowest 0.926). Held rather than revised: the Ti6Al4V/TI-CTL correspondence is unaccepted, the background assumption is not established, and interference is untested.

The authors' 'comparable' rests on ANOVA of means; this comparison computes no statistic and did not classify no_change: 3/20 (24 h) and 1/20 (48 h) combinations fall in the no_change band, all involving one BMG well.

18/20 combinations at 48 h are in the increase band, but both non-increase combinations involve one BMG well (S8), and a raised signal is also what H_int predicts. E3 separates cell number from activity per cell only in part.
No cell-free specimen read exists in the export; the procedure (dye added onto specimens) does not exclude a material contribution.

target_id: the Ti6Al4V wells read above the reagent-only background at the same read
reason: Not established on its check: one TI-CTL well per day (1641 and 1595 RFU) reads within the AB range (1581-1756). Raw-RFU ratios to Ti6Al4V are therefore not ratios of cell signal. Background handling must be declared before the next read.

Kept as recorded; not re-analysed by dropping wells. Five record questions go to the researcher before any re-read: (1) accept or reject TI-CTL = Ti6Al4V and AB = reagent only; (2) was the specimen in the read well; (3) are wells independent specimens, and is the same specimen read at 24 and 48 h; (4) the AB well position conflict (grid C7-C8 vs plate area H8-H9); (5) 'triplicate' vs 4 and 5 wells.
